fields.why: The report presents itself as a surveillance overview (B), but its headline is a 1980-to-1997 decline (28% in deaths, 45% in rate) and the note discusses temporal trends, so adding before/after or trend (A) is also defensible.

brief_issues: Brief does not say whether a surveillance overview whose headline is a trend also gets 'before/after or trend'. B's record lists 9 age groups in groupwise; Table 1 has 8 rated age groups (16-17 to >=65). Only B's record was in the packet; A is rated from its value.
